messages:
devon: Quick heads-up — release cutoff is ~24h from now. Please add changelog entries to your PRs and paste PR numbers here for a final sweep. Attach the one-liner, component tag, and whether a rollback is needed.

maria: Quick Q — what counts as a changelog-worthy change? tiny doc tweaks?

devon: Anything customer-visible (API surface, SDK behavior, config flags, CLI UX), security fixes, or infra changes that could affect customers. Small docs-only typos can skip unless they change meaning.

jason: Adding my PRs now: #4321 (model routing fix) — entry added to PR description.

emily: Will backport to 2.4.x — do we need a separate entry for the backport?

devon: If the backport changes user-visible behaviour (config or output) call it out; otherwise reference the original PR number and add "backport: 2.4.x" in the entry.

release-bot: changelog-lint: ERROR: /pr/4321/changelog.md missing component tag. See https://redwood.internal/changelog-guidelines :exclamation:

maria: Example entry I put in #4319: `model: improve routing fallback to cheaper model (no behavior change for callers) — backport: none` Is that ok?

devon: Close — please follow template and keep one sentence + impact tag. Example we prefer:```
model: prefer cheaper-model fallback when primary is overloaded — reduces cost without changing outputs; no rollback needed.
PR: #4319; component: inference/runtime; impact: low
```

jason: Updated #4321 to match template & added component: inference/routing. Also put PR link here.

release-engineering: Quick reminder: the changelog CI will auto-merge only if entries conform to the template and lint passes. If lint fails by cutoff, we'll queue on the next ship window.

emily: Pinging owners for the backport PRs: @jason @devon — can you confirm by EOD?

devon: Confirming I’ll do the 2.4.x backport and add the entry.

maria: :thumbsup: thanks — attaching PR numbers here for the sweep: [#4321, #4319, #4302].

jason: FYI, I rebased branch and left a note in the PR about changelog. If CI still complains, ping me in-thread.

devon: Final ask: when you add the changelog to a PR, include `component:` and `impact:` fields and put the one-liner in the PR body top. Makes the sweep script happy.

maria: Got it. Last call to add any final entries before cutoff.

release-bot: reminder: release-cutoff in ~3h — please finish edits.

jason: Done for my PRs. Good luck y'all.

devon: Thanks everyone — I’ll run the quick sweep after cutoff and report any lint blockers here.
